scope: Local pasted-article capture, paired Chrome/Edge MV3 companion, and host HTTP boundary

browserRuntimeVerification.method: Real host HTTP tests plus shipped background/content scripts executed with controlled browser API and DOM runtimes. Manual Load unpacked remains a user setup step.

retention.articleOriginal: Extracted plain text and original URL retained in an application/json capture envelope; no full-page HTML.
retention.comments: Personal reading annotations retained separately from source passages

limitations: No general browsing/history surveillance or implicit capture.
Only an explicitly chosen tab is followed; navigation and browser restart stop following.
Scroll and visible/focused dwell are observations, not evidence of comprehension.
Abrupt termination can lose the latest unflushed progress.
Unpacked Chrome/Edge setup is manual; Firefox, protected pages, PDFs, cross-origin iframe text and paywall extraction are not guaranteed.
A queued capture is not confirmed service delivery; retry is explicit.

evidenceArtifacts.screenshots: Dated acceptance captures are local-only and intentionally excluded from Git; they may include personal workspace or account context.
evidenceArtifacts.localBuilds: Installers, retained sources and credential files remain under ignored local paths.
